text:
Which statements about ethanoic acid are correct?
1
Its aqueous solution has a pH value of 10.
2
It reacts with metal carbonates to produce carbon dioxide gas.
3
It reacts with magnesium metal to produce hydrogen gas.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
